run_grpc_interop_test: run the gRPC async interop test client against a server with a specified test case
create_grpc_channel: create a secure or insecure gRPC async channel using server host and port arguments
test_interoperability_async: test gRPC async interoperability by initializing aio, creating a channel, stub, and running a test case
parse_test_case_from_arg: parse a test case string argument and resolve it to the corresponding TestCase enum value
review_test_interoperability: review the async test_interoperability function that orchestrates gRPC aio channel creation and test execution
